picks.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 4.5 with faster, cheaper near-frontier coding
picks.why: Delivers near-frontier coding performance at one-third the cost and double the speed of Claude Sonnet 4.
picks.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 4.5

picks.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 4.6 with 1M context window
picks.why: Upgrades agentic coding and computer use while introducing a 1-million-token context window in beta.
picks.title: Claude Opus 4.6

picks.headline: OpenAI introduces Presence enterprise agent platform for voice and chat
picks.why: Expands OpenAI's enterprise footprint with a platform dedicated to deploying autonomous voice and chat agents.
picks.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence

picks.headline: Malicious issue requests bypass guardrails on major AI coding agents
picks.why: Evaluates tools like Cursor and Claude Code, showing a 66.5% success rate in exploiting coding agents via malicious issues.
picks.title: IssueTrojanBench: Benchmarking AI Coding Agents Against Malicious Issue Requests

picks.headline: Per-token API timing leaks proprietary model architectures and inference optimizations
picks.why: Demonstrates that remote per-token generation timing alone is sufficient to reverse-engineer proprietary LLM architecture and serving configs.
picks.title: Leaky Language Models: Stealing Architecture and Inference Optimizations via Per-Token Timing

picks.headline: HijackKV attack poisons shared KV caches in position-independent reuse systems
picks.why: Exploits KV cache sharing across queries to silently corrupt model outputs when victim requests reuse attacker-aligned prefix vectors.
picks.title: HijackKV: New Threat in Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse

picks.headline: SkewAdam slashes MoE optimizer memory by 97 percent via tiered allocation
picks.why: Allocates optimizer states based on MoE parameter types, vastly lowering memory requirements without sacrificing perplexity.
picks.title: Where Should Optimizer State Live? Tiered State Allocation for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training

papers.headline: GaugeQuant breaks LLM training symmetries to eliminate activation outliers for quantization
papers.why: Modifies the training loss to align LLM weight bases, suppressing activation outliers without harming performance to enable cleaner post-training quantization.
papers.title: GaugeQuant: Online Learning of Quantization-Optimal Bases from LLM Symmetries

papers.headline: Mechanistic study shows LLM sycophancy consists of three distinct internal representations
papers.why: Demonstrates that sycophantic behavior spans three linearly separable internal modes starting at layer 14, despite producing identical surface outputs.
papers.title: Gotta Catch them all: the modes of Sycophancy

papers.headline: Isospectral Optimization adapts language models by re-using base weight spectra
papers.why: Improves post-training efficiency in RL with verifiable rewards by keeping base model weight spectra intact while training input-output singular frames.
papers.title: ISO: An RLVR-Native Optimization Stack
